reuse.why: Reuses extractTagsFromText for the tag, but ignores the tree's existing notes table (where group notes already live, served by notes-get) and reimplements the expense sign flip in setLastMonthSpending instead of sharing it with the averaging actions.

duplication.why: The hidden/template filter is pasted as the same SQL template fragment into five queries, the isFixedGroup and income guards are repeated in every loop, copyPreviousMonth restates the same rule in JS, and setLastMonthSpending copies the whole action skeleton.

placement.why: Adds a new category_groups.notes column, migration and a notes field on DbCategory (the category type, not the group type) for data the tree already stores in the notes table; the exclusion rule is spread across action bodies and SQL strings instead of one place.

scope.why: Includes a schema migration, a mistyped DB type change and unrelated whitespace edits to init.sql (spreadsheet_cells, categories) beyond the requested action behaviour.

maintainability.why: Any change to which categories month-wide actions skip has to be made in six places in two languages (SQL and TS), and the parallel group-notes storage will diverge from the notes the UI edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Group notes are read from a newly added category_groups.notes column instead of the existing notes table (id = group id) that the notes app uses; the exclusion rule is inlined per action rather than through a shared selection.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth expresses the hidden/template/#fixed rule as a JS condition (goal_def !== null, hidden flags, isFixedGroup) while the other five actions express it as an SQL WHERE fragment plus a loop guard: the same rule in reshaped forms.

abstraction_drift.where: No shared category-selection helper exists or is introduced; each of copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and set6MonthAvg applies the includeHiddenCategories, template and #fixed rules on its own.
